chunks: From him, from one of our companions, with regards to
the irrevocably divorced woman, when (her husband) dies from her, and she is in her waiting period, he said: 'She should observe the waiting period by the further of the two terms'.

key_terms.أَبْعَدِ الْأَجَلَيْنِ: The further of the two terms

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a divorced woman if her husband dies during her iddah?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi highlights the principle of 'combining waiting periods' (ijtimāʿ al-ʿiddatayn) in Shia jurisprudence, where the death of the husband and the finality of divorce coincide. The Imam specifies that the woman observes the longer of the two durations—typically the four months and ten days for death rather than the single menstrual cycle for divorce—ensuring clarity in her marital status and lineage. This reflects the scholarly consensus on prioritizing the more significant waiting period to avoid ambiguity in inheritance and remarriage eligibility.
